headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Carmen Mlodzinski earning the win. Nick Gonzales led the Pirates' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Cincinnati Reds also won, taking down the Milwaukee Brewers 7-2 behind Chase Burns' strong performance on the mound. Jose Trevino had a standout game at the plate, hitting 3 home runs and driving in 3 runs.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Bennett Sousa has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation, joining Carlos Rodón, Jason Adam, Mitchell Parker, Matt Chapman, Kris Bubic, Connor Seabold, and Corey Seager on the injured list.

The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen, while the Texas Rangers traded C Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Ben Peoples. The San Francisco Giants traded 1B Buddy Kennedy to the Seattle Mariners for cash.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Brewers 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, led by Chase Burns' strong performance on the mound. Jose Trevino had a standout game at the plate, hitting 3 home runs and driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Rout Marlins 14-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies dominated the Miami Marlins, winning 14-4 behind a strong team effort. Jake McCarthy led the Rockies' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 6-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Tim Herrin earning the win. Brayan Rocchio led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Astros' Bennett Sousa Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have updated the status of LHP Bennett Sousa, transferring him from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Kyle Nicolas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz. Nicolas joins the Nationals' roster as the team looks to strengthen its lineup.
